transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As you know, we're planning an offsite to help improve collaboration after the recent reorganization. I'll be making the final decisions on the format, facilitator, and participation rules, but I want to hear from each of you first. Please share any relevant constraints or preferences you have so I can factor them into the plan. I know Morgan has been suggested as a potential facilitator — I'd welcome your thoughts on that as well.
